column1: # The pairing code of STACK.md §4.6, as cases both ends have to produce.
# The code is a digest over both public keys, which is what makes reading it aloud worth
# anything: somebody standing in the middle holds a different key on each side, so the two
# screens disagree and a person sees it. That only works if the two implementations derive
# it identically, and two readings of one paragraph is not a guarantee of that.
# Keys are hexadecimal. Columns, tab separated: name, desktop key, phone key, the code.
the same bytes on both sides
